events.title: Allied Invasion of Iran
events.detail: Britain and USSR invade Iran to secure oil fields and supply lines. Reza Shah abdicates; his son Mohammad Reza Pahlavi takes the throne.

events.title: CIA Coup (Op. Ajax)
events.detail: CIA and MI6 overthrow PM Mossadegh after he nationalized oil. ~300 killed. Shah consolidated power. CIA acknowledged role in 2013.

events.title: Islamic Revolution
events.detail: Shah flees Jan 16. Khomeini returns Feb 1. Nov 4: Students seize US Embassy; 52 hostages held 444 days. Failed rescue kills 8 US troops.

events.title: Iran-Iraq War
events.detail: Iraq invades Iran; US provides intelligence to Iraq. ~1 million killed total. Chemical weapons used extensively by Iraq.

events.title: Iran Air 655
events.detail: USS Vincennes shoots down civilian Airbus A300 over Strait of Hormuz. All 290 killed including 66 children. US paid $131.8M settlement, never apologized.

events.title: Axis of Evil / Facilities Revealed
events.detail: Bush names Iran in "Axis of Evil." Exile group reveals secret nuclear facilities at Natanz and Arak.

events.title: JCPOA Nuclear Deal
events.detail: Iran agrees to reduce enriched uranium by 97%, limit enrichment to 3.67%, reduce centrifuges by two-thirds, allow IAEA inspections.

events.title: Trump Exits JCPOA
events.detail: Trump withdraws from JCPOA despite IAEA confirming Iranian compliance. Reimposed "maximum pressure" sanctions. Iran begins exceeding JCPOA limits in 2019.

events.title: Soleimani Killed
events.detail: US drone strike at Baghdad airport kills IRGC Quds Force commander Soleimani and Iraqi PMF deputy al-Muhandis. Iran retaliates with missiles at Al Asad, wounding 110 US troops.

events.title: Oct 7 Attack & Gaza War
events.detail: Hamas attacks southern Israel, killing ~1,200. Israel invades Gaza. Regional escalation with Hezbollah, Houthis, and Iran-backed militias.

events.title: First Iran-Israel Exchange
events.detail: Israel bombs Iranian consulate in Damascus. Iran launches 170+ drones and 100+ ballistic missiles at Israel; ~99% intercepted. Israel strikes Isfahan.

events.title: Second Exchange
events.detail: Iran fires ballistic missiles at Israel. Israel destroys most of Iran's Russian-supplied S-300 air defense systems near Tehran.

events.title: Twelve-Day War
events.detail: Israel launches 200+ jets at 100+ targets. US enters with B-2 bombers. 600+ Iranians killed. IRGC chief Salami and nuclear scientists killed. Ceasefire June 24.

era: 2026 War — Operation Epic Fury / Roaring Lion

events.title: War Begins — Khamenei Killed in Opening Strike
events.detail: Israel and the US launch coordinated decapitation strikes on Iran on February 28, 2026, killing Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and multiple senior IRGC commanders. Iran retaliates with missile and drone barrages across the region, opening the widest Iran-Israel-US war to date.

events.title: Mojtaba Khamenei Elected Supreme Leader
events.detail: Iran's Assembly of Experts elects Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the slain Ali Khamenei, as the new Supreme Leader on March 8, 2026. He is reported to have been severely wounded in the February 28 strike and does not appear publicly for months afterward.

events.title: April 8 Ceasefire
events.detail: After six weeks of intense fighting, the US, Israel, and Iran agree to a ceasefire on April 8, 2026. The truce proves fragile, punctuated by repeated tanker attacks, cross-border strikes, and a continuing Israel-Hezbollah war in Lebanon.

events.title: Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding Signed
events.detail: Trump signs the 14-point Islamabad MOU at the Palace of Versailles on June 17; Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian signs remotely from Tehran. Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif signs as mediator. Terms include a permanent halt to operations on all fronts (including Lebanon), phased US naval blockade removal, 60 days of guaranteed safe passage through Hormuz, and a 60-day window to negotiate a final deal.

events.title: State Funeral of Ali Khamenei
events.detail: Iran holds a multi-day state funeral for Ali Khamenei (July 3-9) across Tehran, Qom, Najaf, and Karbala, with burial at the Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad. Millions attend; mourners chant 'Death to America, Death to Israel.' Successor Mojtaba Khamenei does not appear at his own father's funeral.

events.title: Islamabad MOU Collapses
events.detail: Following a wave of Iranian strikes on four commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz (July 6-7), Trump declares the MOU 'over' (July 8) and the US resumes strikes on Iranian territory and imposes a naval blockade. By July 15, Iran's top negotiator Ghalibaf declares the MOU void and Iran in an 'existential war' with the US, after IRGC strikes on US assets in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan. Active fighting continues through July 16.

events.title: Iran and Oman Agree Temporary Hormuz Navigation Corridor
events.detail: After weeks of on-and-off talks, Iran and Oman agree a temporary joint navigational corridor through the Strait of Hormuz (~7 miles wide, entry and part of exit through Iranian waters) plus a joint mine-clearing project, with 30-60 days of further talks toward a permanent route. It is the first concrete de-escalation of the Hormuz blockade since the June MOU's 60-day safe-passage window lapsed in mid-August; Iran insists full reopening still requires US sanctions relief and release of frozen assets. Brent crude fell to a two-week low (~$86/bbl) on the news.
